title: The Poconos summers and the Ringling Brothers Circus at Madison Square Garden
summary: From 1971 he worked Unity House in the Poconos each summer and Ringling Brothers at the Garden and Nassau Coliseum each spring and fall.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: At the Unity -- Unity House, yes, Unity House. And then in the spring, every spring since '71 I've been doing Ringling Brothers Circus at the Garden when they come into the Garden. And we're getting ready to start it tomorrow out in Coliseum.
This the first time you played it out at Nassau?
No, no, every year since -- every year since '71.

Uh-huh. We do -- well, we started out doing eight weeks at the Garden, and now we're doing 12, and this year we're going to do 13 weeks at the Garden. And we do -- always do about ten days to two weeks out in Nassau every year in November. And they're coming to the garden in March.
